create.name: Jonathan Lehmann
create.bio:
Jonathan Lehmann is a French meditation teacher and writer who spent six years as a corporate lawyer in New York before leaving the law to look for a more meaningful life. Raised in Paris, he spent three years travelling to meet teachers in India, Sri Lanka, Brazil, California and Italy, learning meditation, yoga and shamanic practices along the way. In 2015 he began Les Antisèches du Bonheur, which translates as the Happiness Cheatsheets: a blog that grew into a large French-speaking community built on short, practical habits for steadier moods and kinder relationships, drawing on Buddhist teaching, ancient philosophy and modern psychology.

He teaches mainly through guided meditations, many of them playful, such as visualisations built around film and book characters. On Insight Timer he offers free practices in English and French and five ten-day courses on self-love, fear, joy and wonder. He has written three books in French: a diary of his first silent retreat and travels, a handbook of his happiness method, and an account of a week of ayahuasca ceremonies. With Silence, a project he runs with Jeanne, he leads silent meditation retreats in France and Portugal, and he also hosts an English-language book club on Telegram.

books.title: Les antisèches du bonheur: La méthode simple et follement efficace pour vivre plus heureux
books.author: Jonathan Lehmann
books.description: Jonathan's handbook of the Happiness Cheatsheets method, in French. It sets out a series of short principles and daily exercises, many built on meditation, for meeting difficult thoughts and making room for more joy.

books.title: Journal intime d'un touriste du bonheur
books.author: Jonathan Lehmann
books.description: His first book, in French: a frank diary of a ten-day silent meditation retreat in India and the months of travel that followed after he left his legal career.

books.title: Journal intime d'un voyageur chamanique
books.author: Jonathan Lehmann
books.description: A first-person account, in French, of a week in 2020 when he took part in four nights of ayahuasca ceremonies. He writes about facing his own shadow and what he brought back into daily life.

courses.title: Radical Self Love
courses.description: A ten-day English course of meditations, visualisations and affirmations. Each day looks at a different layer of the self, from social masks and the inner child to boundaries, needs and the higher self.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: The Magic Of Life
courses.description: Ten English lessons on noticing the small wonders of ordinary days and treating setbacks as teachers. Topics include the unknown, the body's wisdom, gratitude, speech and letting life flow.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Masterclass Jonathan Lehmann : les antisèches du bonheur
courses.description: A recorded French-language video masterclass of seventeen lessons on his happiness method and on learning to love yourself. It sits inside the MentorShow subscription library.
courses.price: Included in MentorShow subscription (under €17 EUR a month for the first year, then €60 EUR a month, billed annually)

free_resources.title: Jonathan Lehmann on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: More than thirty free guided meditations in English and French, including his well-loved morning meditation with music, plus talks on joy, self-love and presence. Free to hear in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Pop Culture Meditations (free bundle)
free_resources.description: A free download of light-hearted guided meditations that borrow qualities from favourite characters, such as Yoda's calm and Hermione's resourcefulness, as a way into practice.

free_resources.title: Happiness Book Club
free_resources.description: An English-language channel on Telegram where Jonathan shares and discusses books on living, loving and wonder. Joining is free.

flags: Email is the brand inbox for Les Antisèches du Bonheur (contact@lesantiseches.com), shown in the footer of his English about page and on /contact.

All YouTube videos and all three books are in French; YouTube shows English auto-translated titles to English-language visitors, but the original French titles are used here. His Insight Timer courses are in English.
His YouTube channel is now shared with Jeanne (his partner in the Silence retreats), per a channel notice; Facebook and Instagram run under the brand name Les Antisèches du Bonheur.
Amazon.com /dp/ pages returned error 500 to direct requests; the three ASINs come from amazon.com product URLs in search results (titles and ISBNs match), not from a page load. Covers not checked.

No upcoming Silence retreat is listed (the most recent was July 2026); booking_url points to the Silence home page. Progress lead gives Lisbon as base, but no page shows where he teaches in person, so availability is worldwide.
Journal intime d'un voyageur chamanique is about ayahuasca; its publisher blurb mentions therapeutic properties, which the description here leaves out. A human may want to confirm it fits.

YouTube 'IFS Meditation: Meeting an Inner Protector' (therapy model, borderline), 'Méditation pour accompagner la guérison' (healing-titled), the Vipassana talk with a drugs title, forest-sounds track and clips under 3 minutes.
